title: 4/04 1am check-results cron posted a second public 'Streak reset to 0' result reply
tier_reason: a duplicate public result reply repeating the scheduler's reply (wording on the public feed); the unguarded streak re-application on the same path is recorded as I-011

contract.text: The scheduler's result polling posts the single result reply; the 1am check-results cron is a safety net that updates only the local pick file.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md at 0e23c0f (result polling 'Posts reply (✅/❌ + streak)'; '1am cron remains as a safety-net bts check-results fallback'); clarified at ac7bc40 ('does NOT post to Bluesky; scheduler owns all posting')

mechanism.text: check_results replied to the pick's Bluesky thread whenever daily.bluesky_uri was set, with no check that result polling had already replied or resolved the pick; 0c7797b (4/03 11:21) had added the reply to both the scheduler and the cron

residual.text: 619d109 removed only the reply: check_results still re-applied an already-resolved result to streak.json (no change on a miss day, a double count on a hit day) until 5e02676 on 4/05 (I-011)

watchdog.trigger: display/wording only: a duplicate public reply with the same content; the state defect on the same path (I-011) carries the grading watchdog
watchdog.recovery_assertion: each delivered pick thread has at most one result reply

evidence.what: the scheduler's result polling already posts the ❌/✅ reply; the 1am check-results cron had no guard, 'causing a second "Streak reset to 0" reply on miss days'; the cron now only updates the local pick file

evidence.locator: git history: 0c7797b (4/03 11:21 ET) added the result reply to src/bts/cli.py and src/bts/scheduler.py; scripts/cron-setup-pi5.sh 1am line
evidence.what: 4/04 01:00 was the first cron run after both writers could reply; 619d109 was committed ten minutes later
the reply block ran after grading with no already-resolved or already-replied guard
first successful deploy run whose head (4a82cf8) contains 619d109; a Fly.io deploy, log expired
